versions.title: Cardiac myosin inhibitors and 3 more drugs
versions.summary: Adds 5 drugs: the HCM-specific cardiac myosin inhibitors mavacamten and aficamten, plus dofetilide, cibenzoline and ranolazine. All references verified against PubMed.

versions.title: Initial release
versions.summary: The original 73 drugs described in Haris et al. (2026), J. Comput. Biophys. Chem. 25(09), 1341-1350. Text encoding, drug-class names and reference formatting were standardized in Nov 2026 without changing the scientific content.
